授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Calculus, first introduced by Newton and Leibniz in the seventeenth century, is one of the cornerstones of modern mathematics. It finds application in all areas of science and engineering and beyond. In this course, which assumes no pre-requisite knowledge other than the ability to do basic algebraic manipulations, we introduce the concepts of functions, limits, continuity, derivative functions and definite and indefinite integration, and discuss examples of their application.

head: 授業のテーマ
授業の内容（90分授業＝2時間）
事前/事後学修の内容
rows: Introduction to number sets and the concept of real functions.
Composite functions definition and calculation, inverse functions
product rule, chain rule, applications of differentiation
Extreme values, curve sketching, Newton's method
Fundamental theorem of calculus, indefinite integration
integration by parts, integration by substitution
Further topics in integration by substitution
inverse trigonometric functions, hyperbolic functions and inverse hyperbolic functions
Integration of rational functions - an algorithmic approach
area between curves, centre of mass, volume of solid of revolution, length of curve
